filename.Description: The run's beh/ file, relative to the session folder. One row per run, so each run of a visit keeps its own initial assessment.

acq_time.Description: When the initial assessment of this run was annotated, in ISO-8601 with its UTC offset; the first configuration's time when there was none.

medications.Description: Medications at this run, as noted in its initial assessment, free text.

program_id.Description: Stimulation program the patient arrived on.

left_anode.Description: Left anode contact(s) in the contact grammar: case for the can, E2 for a ring, E2b for one segment, _ joining several.

left_cathode.Description: Left cathode contact(s), same grammar as left_anode.

left_amplitude.Description: Left amplitude in mA. A single value, or per-contact values joined by _ in left_cathode order when current is steered (3.3_2.2 is 5.5 mA split 60/40). It carries no Units because a steered value is not a single number; sum the parts for the delivered current.

right_anode.Description: Right anode contact(s), same grammar as left_anode.

right_cathode.Description: Right cathode contact(s), same grammar as left_anode.

right_amplitude.Description: Right amplitude in mA, same shape as left_amplitude.

notes.Description: Notes of the initial assessment of this run.

scale_mds_updrs_part_iii.Description: The run's initial assessment: its clinical scales, named as in the session files' scale_<name> columns. The stimulation columns hold the settings the patient arrived on.

scale_pdq_39.Description: The run's initial assessment: its clinical scales, named as in the session files' scale_<name> columns. The stimulation columns hold the settings the patient arrived on.
